svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Use Twitter as his go-to news app to follow what is happening around the world via trendin
g hashtags. → Stay connected to the world so that he never remains unaware of something bi
g that has happened.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Stay connected to his friends in real time (e.g., via Snapchat instant photo and video sha
ring). → Know what is happening in his friend circle, with friends back in India, and arou
nd him locally (campus, class, classmates) through social networking apps.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Keep track of all his social media account credentials and 2FA backup codes in a digital v
ault (currently Google Password Manager), since losing it would mean losing most of his ac
count details. → Ensure no one else can access his accounts on any social media platform.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Have one common, self-designed platform that aggregates content from all his favorite soci
al media apps in one place so he does not waste time switching between apps. → Be shown an
assortment of different kinds of content rather than one repeated stream (e.g., Instagram
repeatedly showing food videos).

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Have his data encrypted on the social media platforms he uses. → Prevent people he does no
t know from seeing through his texts or conversations with friends.

g.aria-label: 待确认联系 · 有助于
g.text: 待确认联系 · 有助于
Have new posts load in real time without lag so he does not have to scroll back up to refr
esh and risk missing posts. → Find the right content he is looking for when using social m
edia.
